query:
The group has a norm that plans are confirmed in the chat before being assumed to be happening. Which member does not follow this norm in practice, and what specific pattern of behaviour in the conversations shows they treat it as inapplicable to themselves?

Options:
A. Seb
B. Marcus
C. Priyanka
D. Zara
context:
[1] (about=Zara, episodic, t10 @2026-02-12T19:44:00) You do not ask when you are the one doing it, Seb. That is somewhat the point.
[2] (about=Zara, episodic, t6 @2026-01-29T19:49:00) We are not annoyed at you. We just want to know in advance so we can plan accordingly. That is not too much to ask.
[3] (about=Seb, episodic, t9 @2026-02-12T19:40:00) lads who's sorting the escape room booking for Saturday
[4] (about=Priyanka, episodic, t10 @2026-02-12T19:45:00) already on it 👍 2pm Saturday confirmed, they had a slot

[6] (about=Seb, episodic, t10 @2026-02-12T19:52:00) lads are you two doing things without us now 😂
[7] (about=Marcus, said_by=Nadia, core, t12 @2026-02-19T19:55:00) Marcus acknowledged he has been a vague maybe at every plan since October, has been in his own head due to a breakup that hit harder than he let on, and will try to show up properly going forward.
[8] (about=Marcus, core, t6 @2026-01-29T19:23:00) needs to know which weekend, can't commit to something weeks out
[9] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-insight, t12 @2026-02-19T19:55:00) Nadia called out Marcus for being a vague maybe at every plan since October, noting the group misses him being properly here, and Saturday was the first time in months he showed up without hedging.
[10] (about=Priyanka, episodic, t4 @2026-01-22T19:47:00) oh no 😂 what did she mean by that, did she know about your job?
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Seb, group-interaction, t0 @2026-01-08T19:14:00) Group decided to meet Sunday evening at a decent non-chain place, with Zara and Nadia confirming Sunday works if it feeds six at a normal hour and finishes at a sensible time, Marcus also available
[12] (about=Theo, episodic, t14 @2026-02-26T19:40:00) we met because Marcus accidentally walked into the wrong A&E bay and Nadia was the one who had to redirect him. you're right, camping is conservative
[13] (about=Zara, core, t0 @2026-01-08T19:14:00) client's instructions held up in form but whether they reflect his actual wants will resolve in about six weeks
[14] (about=Zara, core, t6 @2026-01-29T19:23:00) told Seb they are not annoyed at him, just want to know in advance to plan accordingly
agent_answer:
A. **Seb**

The pattern is that **Seb does not ask or confirm in advance when he is the one organizing/doing the plan** — he assumes it is happening without checking with the group.

This is shown directly in Zara’s message to him:

> “You do not ask when you are the one doing it, Seb. That is somewhat the point.”

And also:

> “We just want to know in advance so we can plan accordingly. That is not too much to ask.”

So Seb treats the “confirm in chat” norm as something others must do for him, but not something he has to follow himself.

query:
The group has a stated norm that the role of booking and organising rotates — it does not fall to the same person every time. Which members are not following this norm in practice, and what in the conversations reveals their non-compliance?

Options:
A. Nadia and Theo
B. Seb and Marcus
C. Priyanka and Seb
D. Zara and Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Zara, episodic, t10 @2026-02-12T19:41:00) I am done making all the reservations. I have done it for every single outing this month. Someone else can do it.
[2] (about=Zara, episodic, t10 @2026-02-12T19:44:00) You do not ask when you are the one doing it, Seb. That is somewhat the point.
[3] (about=Seb, episodic, t9 @2026-02-12T19:40:00) lads who's sorting the escape room booking for Saturday
[4] (about=Priyanka, episodic, t10 @2026-02-12T19:45:00) already on it 👍 2pm Saturday confirmed, they had a slot
[5] (about=Theo, episodic, t10 @2026-02-12T19:45:00) fair point. Priyanka has the website, she mentioned it last week. Priyanka can you just confirm the slot?
[6] (about=Priyanka, episodic, t6 @2026-01-29T19:54:00) so I'll look into booking it then? the one near Waterloo has good reviews
[7] (about=Zara, episodic, t2 @2026-01-15T19:43:00) Took me ten minutes to find a place that was not a chain and could actually seat six at a reasonable hour. Noted for future reference: this is not trivial.
[8] (about=Seb, episodic, t8 @2026-02-05T19:32:00) honestly tho Priyanka doing a dinner in is actually the right move, I feel like we've done four restaurant things in a row
[9] (about=Seb, episodic, t0 @2026-01-08T19:27:00) lads should we actually do something this weekend? feels like we've been saying that since November and then nothing happens
[10] (about=Seb, episodic, t0 @2026-01-08T19:27:00) Sunday evening? somewhere decent, not a chain obv 😂
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Priyanka, group-interaction, t14 @2026-02-26T19:30:00) Group decided to do a camping weekend in Wales, with Priyanka to send options by Tuesday and full itinerary by next Thursday, Marcus to sort kit list, Zara needs proper sleeping arrangements, Nadia needs times a week in advance
[12] (about=Zara, core, t10 @2026-02-12T19:41:00) has made all the reservations for every outing this month and is done doing it, wants someone else to handle it
agent_answer:
**Correct option: C. Priyanka and Seb** are the members whose actions keep the booking/organising role from actually rotating.

- **Seb** – He asks, *“lads who's sorting the escape room booking for Saturday”* instead of simply doing it himself. Zara explicitly calls this out: *“You do not ask when you are the one doing it, Seb. That is somewhat the point.”* So Seb is leaving the booking to others rather than taking his turn.

- **Priyanka** – She keeps ending up as the organiser/booker: she says *“already on it 👍 2pm Saturday confirmed”*, and earlier said *“so I’ll look into booking it then?”*. The memory also shows her as the one sending options and the itinerary for the camping weekend. So the organising role keeps falling to the same person instead of being rotated.

**Others:**
- **Zara** is the one complaining that she has made every reservation and wants someone else to handle it — she is the source of the evidence, not the one perpetuating the failure.
- **Nadia** and **Marcus** have no record showing them taking or avoiding the role.
- **Theo** delegates to Priyanka, but the pair clearly revealed as non-compliant by the evidence is **Priyanka and Seb**.
